analysis.title: Sprint Planning Call
analysis.summary: The team reviewed sprint progress for payments and frontend. The payments API is about eighty percent complete, with Stripe working but refunds and webhooks outstanding. Frontend checkout is complete and mobile-tested, but blocked by missing design tokens. The group decided to launch on the twenty-second to allow proper QA, assigned ownership for payments QA, frontend regression, and launch tasks, and deferred the monitoring tool choice pending a comparison doc.
keyPoints: The payments API is about eighty percent done; Stripe integration is working, but refunds and webhooks remain.
Bob expects to finish the refund flow by Friday and will prepare a webhook retry design doc by Wednesday.
Frontend checkout is done and tested on mobile, but Carol is blocked on new design tokens from the design team.
Speaker 1 will follow up with the design team to get tokens to Carol by end of day.
The team chose the twenty-second launch date to allow a full week of QA.
Monitoring tool evaluation is ongoing between Grafana and Datadog.
decisions: Table the monitoring tool decision for now and decide next Monday.
